cohort: The study included 507 children diagnosed with neurodevelopmental disorders, categorized into Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD, n=234) and non-ASD (nASD, n=273) groups.
finding: Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ART) were more frequent in children with ASD compared to those with other neurodevelopmental disorders, but this association appeared mediated by perinatal and parental risk factors rather than ART being an independent causal exposure.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be significantly associated with ART within the ASD group.
